title: The Fed JUST Bailed us Out AGAIN | What do they SEE?!?!?!
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: Fed officials (Williams) are coming out to talk down rate-hike pricing whenever markets sell off, effectively propping up the market.
Hikes can't fix AI- and oil-driven supply inflation and will mainly hurt the labor market.
Heavy AI-related debt issuance (SpaceX, Broadcom, Oracle) is widening spreads and competing with stocks; something may be starting to break.
Disagrees with Williams: ~54% of CPI categories run above 3% y/y, so inflation is broad-based.

calls.reason: Chip stocks recovering after Fed comments; Broadcom bounced off 355.
calls.quote: Look at that bounce off of 355 for Broadcom. I think that's a great entry, actually.

calls.reason: Nvidia bounced from 227 as Fed commentary supported chips.
Fed officials' dovish comments keep supporting the market above the 735 level.
calls.quote: the Fed seems right now keen on propping this market up.

notes: No date stated; mentions CPI 'tomorrow'. The '735 line' instrument is ambiguous (spoken alongside Nasdaq); recorded as ES/SPY, low conviction. AVGO/NVDA levels are bounce points.
